# Stardew Valley Planner

> A browser-based Stardew Valley farm-layout planner with English and Simplified Chinese planning articles and browser-local projects.

## English

Stardew Valley Planner helps you plan farm layouts in your browser. Projects stay in your browser and the site does not require an account or cloud sync.

### Planner and reference

- [Stardew Valley Planner](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art): Plan a Stardew Valley farm layout in your browser.
- [Privacy policy](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/privacy): Learn how browser-local projects and site data are handled.
- [Terms of service](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/terms): Read the browser-local terms, including optional JSON import and export and the fan-made status.

### Planning guides

- [Stardew Valley Planning Guides](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/blog): Browse practical guides for planning a clearer, more flexible farm.
- [Planning guide archive](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/blog/archive): Browse every Stardew Valley planning guide.
- [Carpenter Stardew: Which Robin Service Do You Need Today?](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/carpenter-stardew): Match your task—buy, build, upgrade, or move—to the menu and verify the shop can serve you.
- [Robin's Shop Is Empty? Find Her in Stardew Valley Today](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/where-is-robin-stardew-valley): Learn why Robin leaves the counter, where she goes on Tuesday and Friday, and when rain or farm construction changes the answer today.
- [Stardew Valley NPC Guide: Gifts, Marriage, and Services](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/stardew-valley-npc): Compare current friendship groups, gift rules, marriage candidates, and the NPC services that shape your building, animal, and tool plans.
- [Stardew Valley Town Map: Pelican Town Landmarks & Routes](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/stardew-valley-town-map): Use this Stardew Valley town map guide to find Pelican Town landmarks, exits, and a route back to your farm before you plan its layout.

## 简体中文

星露谷农场规划器可帮助你在浏览器中规划农场布局。项目保留在浏览器本地，不需要账户或云端同步。

### 规划器与参考内容

- [星露谷农场规划器](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/zh): 在浏览器中规划《星露谷物语》农场布局。
- [隐私政策](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/zh/privacy): 了解浏览器本地项目和站点数据的处理方式。
- [服务条款](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/zh/terms): 阅读浏览器本地服务条款，包括可选 JSON 导入导出和同人创作说明。

### 农场规划指南

- [星露谷农场规划指南](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/zh/blog): 浏览帮助你更清晰、更灵活规划农场的实用指南。
- [规划指南归档](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/zh/blog/archive): 浏览全部星露谷农场规划指南。
- [星露谷木匠：今天该选罗宾的哪项服务？](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/zh/carpenter-stardew): 根据购买、建造、升级或移动的实际需求，选择对应菜单并确认罗宾木匠商店能接单。
- [罗宾的商店没人？今天去哪里找她](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/zh/where-is-robin-stardew-valley): 了解罗宾为什么会离开柜台、周二和周五会去哪里，以及下雨或农场施工会如何改变她当天的行程。
- [星露谷 NPC 指南：礼物、婚姻与服务](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/zh/stardew-valley-npc): 比较当前好感度分类、送礼规则、可结婚候选，以及会影响建筑、动物和工具规划的 NPC 服务。
- [星露谷物语小镇地图：鹈鹕镇地点与路线](https://stardewvalleyplanner.art/zh/stardew-valley-town-map): 用这份鹈鹕镇地点与出口指南，先找到商店、海滩、深山和回农场的路，再开始安排你的农场布局。
